thread.title: Netflix Stock Seen As Fairly Valued Ahead Of Likely Solid Earnings Report

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Netflix Stock Seen As Fairly Valued Ahead Of Likely Solid Earnings Report
text:
Internet television network Netflix ( NFLX ) is likely to report solid subscriber gains in the second quarter thanks to popular original shows like "Lost in Space," "Marvel's Jessica Jones" and "13 Reasons Why," Wall Street analysts are saying. But investment bank Baird doesn't see much room for the highflying stock to climb.
X Baird analyst William Power on Monday reiterated his neutral rating on the stock, but raised his price target to 390 from 300. That's close to its price as of the end of last week. Netflix shares rose 1.7% to 398.18 on the stock market today .
"With a number of high-profile releases in the quarter, led by '13 Reasons Why,' we expect subscriber addition momentum to continue," Power said in a report. His firm's quarterly U.S. subscriber survey and international checks suggest "another strong quarter" for Netflix, he said.
But Power sees Netflix stock as fairly valued at current levels. It hit an all-time high of 423.21 on June 21 before pulling back.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Netflix Stock Buoyed By Subscriber Growth "We remain concerned with the free cash flow losses and potential for increased competition long term from Amazon, Apple ( AAPL ) and others, but expect strong subscriber growth to continue to support the shares," he said.
Amazon.com ( AMZN ) is Netflix's current biggest rival in streaming video with its Amazon Prime Video service. But Apple and Walt Disney ( DIS ) are set to offer competing over-the-top video services next year.
Netflix is scheduled to report second-quarter financial results after the market close on July 16.
Wall Street is modeling Netflix to earn 80 cents a share on sales of $3.94 billion in the June quarter. In the year-earlier period, it earned 15 cents a share on sales of $2.79 billion.
Netflix predicted at the start of the quarter that it would add 6.2 million new streaming subscribers in the quarter. That would give it a worldwide total of 131.2 million subscribers.
